name: Postiz
summary: Schedule and publish posts to connected social channels (X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and more) and read their analytics.

api_key.description: A Postiz API key (Postiz Settings), or an OAuth token starting with pos_. Sent as the raw Authorization header value, with no Bearer prefix.

notes: Postiz Cloud only; a self-hosted instance serves the same API at https://<your-domain>/api/public/v1, which this entry does not reach.
The API says integration where the UI says channel: every integration id comes from GET /integrations, never the platform name.
Rate limit: 100 requests per hour on Cloud, counted on the create-post endpoint only; batch several posts in one call.
A DELETE that answers 404 means already deleted.

endpoints.name: List connected channels
endpoints.summary: Connected social accounts (integrations) with their ids and platforms.

group.description: Only channels assigned to this customer (group) id.

endpoints.name: List posts in a date range
endpoints.summary: Scheduled and published posts between two dates.

customer.description: Only posts of this customer id.

endpoints.name: Get channel analytics
endpoints.summary: Metrics such as followers, impressions and engagement for one channel, per day.

integration.description: Integration id from postiz.integrations.list (not the platform name).

date.description: Days to look back, e.g. 7, 30 or 90.

notes: Metrics differ by platform; some (e.g. Google My Business) return an empty payload rather than an error. 404 means the channel was disconnected.

endpoints.name: Get post analytics
endpoints.summary: Likes, comments, shares, impressions and similar for one published post.

date.description: Days to look back, e.g. 7, 30 or 90.

endpoints.name: Find the next free posting slot
endpoints.summary: Next available time slot for posting to a channel.

endpoints.name: List notifications
endpoints.summary: Organization notifications, newest first, 100 per page.

endpoints.name: Create or schedule posts
endpoints.summary: Publishes now, schedules, or drafts posts on one or more channels.

tags.description: Tags, each {value, label}; may be empty.

posts.description: Required unless type is draft. Each item: {integration: {id}, value: [{content, image: [{id, path}]}], settings: {__type: <platform>, ...platform options}}.

notes: type now publishes to the real accounts immediately. Each platform has its own settings schema (docs.postiz.com/public-api/providers/<platform>).
Counts against the 100-per-hour limit; the body is capped at 50 MB, so upload media first and reference its path instead of inlining base64.

endpoints.name: Upload media from a URL
endpoints.summary: Fetches a public HTTPS URL and stores it as a Postiz media asset for use in posts.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the file.

adjust.description: Resize/re-encode to platform limits in the background (poll GET /media/{id}/status); default false.

notes: Private IPs, link-local addresses and localhost are refused; the MIME type must be on Postiz's upload allowlist.
